title: 22 Weapons, One Deadly Asteroid - HYPERVIOLENT
excerpt: HYPERVIOLENT brings retro FPS action and sci-fi survival horror to Xbox Series X|S and PS5. Explore a doomed asteroid and wield 22 brutal weapons.
content:
A distress call from a remote asteroid should be cause for concern. Arriving to find an entire mining colony consumed by violence? That’s considerably worse.

HYPERVIOLENT takes players into the depths of a doomed space station, mixing the chunky visuals of classic 1990s shooters with survival horror, exploration and some seriously brutal firefights.

Published by Fulqrum Publishing and developed by nfoPRINCE, it’s available now on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 for £16.99 on the Xbox Store.

At A Glance

  • Game: HYPERVIOLENT
  • Developer: nfoPRINCE
  • Publisher: Fulqrum Publishing
  • Platforms: Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5
  • Price: £16.99 on Xbox
  • Genre: Retro FPS / Survival Horror

Welcome To Commodus Asteroid 27-C

Your mission begins with a distress signal from a remote mining outpost, but the situation quickly becomes a fight for survival. The inhabitants of Commodus Asteroid 27-C have descended into violence, leaving you to investigate what happened and uncover the evil lurking deep within the mines.

Fourteen detailed areas await exploration, combining low-poly 3D environments, hand-crafted pixel art and atmospheric lighting. Data logs, crew notes and computer terminals help piece together the station’s downfall, while keycards, switches and security systems open up new routes through its sprawling corridors.

Bring Plenty Of Firepower

HYPERVIOLENT offers 22 ranged and melee weapons, with dual-wielding combinations giving players plenty of ways to deal with the station’s monstrous inhabitants. However, ammunition and equipment aren’t unlimited. Salvaging weapons for parts, repairing gear and managing your inventory are essential if you want to avoid entering a boss fight unprepared.

The game also blends role-playing mechanics into its old-school first-person shooting, with weapon upgrades and environmental interactions adding depth beyond the gunplay. Its influences most certainly lean towards atmospheric sci-fi horror rather than straightforward arcade shooting, making exploration just as important as pulling the trigger.

Can You Survive The Deepest Levels?

With its isolated asteroid setting, resource management and retro-inspired visuals, HYPERVIOLENT offers a darker take on classic FPS action. There’s no backup waiting around the corner, and the deeper you venture into Commodus, the closer you get to the truth behind its horrifying collapse.

HYPERVIOLENT is available now on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5, priced at £16.99 on the Xbox Store. Load your weapons, keep an eye on your supplies and prepare to discover what went so terribly wrong beneath the surface.
